1184943.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 45 warm white LEDs illuminate the circular ring and central Christmas tree silhouette for an eye-catching festive display.
- Position this festive decoration without a nearby mains socket, thanks to its 3 x AA battery power supply.
- Use the included remote control to operate the decoration and select its multi-action lighting functions.
- Select a 4-hour, 6-hour or 8-hour timer setting to control how long the illuminated display stays on.
- Suction cups are included for convenient indoor hanging. Approximate size: 33cm high x 31cm long x 1cm wide.
- Battery-operated design uses 3 x AA batteries, allowing cordless placement indoors.
- Multi-action lighting functions provide a choice of festive illumination effects.
- Warm white LED lighting gives the Christmas tree silhouette and circular ring a gentle seasonal glow.
- Compact 33cm x 31cm size suits windows and smaller indoor decorative areas.
- For indoor use only. To change the ring from flat to 3D, carefully rotate the inner ring where it joins the outer ring at the top and bottom.

## Information
Create a warm festive display with this Samuel Alexander hanging Christmas tree ring. The circular decoration features 45 warm white LEDs surrounding a central Christmas tree silhouette, adding seasonal illumination to windows, walls and other indoor areas. Battery operation allows flexible placement without a nearby mains socket, while the included remote control provides convenient access to the multi-action lighting functions. Choose a 4-hour, 6-hour or 8-hour timer setting to suit your preferred routine. Suction cups are included for easy hanging in a suitable indoor location. The decoration measures approximately 33cm high, 31cm long and 1cm wide, making it a practical choice for windows and smaller display areas. To change the ring from flat to 3D, carefully rotate the inner ring where it joins the outer ring at the top and bottom. Requires 3 x AA batteries, not included. Suitable for indoor use only.

## Features
- Set of 10 acrylic icicle lights (3m lit length)
- 40 LEDs (Choice of White or Warm White)
- Timer function (6 hours On/18 hours Off)
- Outdoor-safe battery pack with 50cm cable
- Requires 4 x AA batteries (not included)

## Information
Add a bright, enchanting glow to your home this Christmas with these Battery Operated Icicle Lights from Christow. Suitable for indoors and outdoors, the string lights contain 10 hanging icicles, beautifully lit by 40 flashing LEDs. With a lit length of 3m, they look fabulous adding a festive glow to rooflines and guttering. Plus, they come in choice of colours to suit your festive theme and create your dream display. 10 x Acrylic LED Icicles Light string contains five large icicles, each containing five LEDs, and five small icicles, each containing three LEDs. The icicles have a clear acrylic construction for a bright, enchanting glow. Plus, a white painted finish on top to create a melting ice effect. Flash Memory Function Love a bit of festive sparkle? Select from 8 light sequences, ranging from twinkly effects to a normal static glow. For convenience, we've also added a memory chip. So, the lights will always remember the last setting selected when turned back on. Timer Function No need to worry about turning the lights on and off each night. Simply turn them on at your desired time when first using them. After that, they'll automatically light up at the same time every night. Plus, they'll automatically turn off after six hours. Outdoor-Safe Battery Pack Powered by 4 x AA batteries with an outdoor-safe IP44-rated battery box. Gives you the freedom to display the lights anywhere, inside or outside your home. Battery box has a 50cm clear cable. So, you can easily hide it behind nearby objects or foliage. What You Need to Know: String of 10 x Acrylic Icicle Lights 5 x small icicles (3 LEDs per icicle) 5 x larger icicles (5 LEDs per icicle Lit Length: 300cm (30cm spacing) 8 flash features (7 effects + static) Timer function (6hrs On/18hrs Off) Outdoor-safe battery pack (IP44-rated) Requires 4 x AA batteries (not included)
